about: Catalogue expansion for the beta. Facts (year, length, credits) were compiled from general knowledge; where an open source matches a work, its values replace these and the change is recorded (fact_sources). Terms, advisories and summaries are AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. Ratings are unverified.

works.title: The Godfather
works.summary: The ageing head of a New York crime family hands power to the son who swore he would never join the business.

graphic-violence: Shootings and killings shown with blood.

works.title: Pulp Fiction
works.summary: Two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers cross paths in a looping Los Angeles underworld.

graphic-violence: Sudden, bloody shootings and a brutal assault.
sexual-content: A sexual assault, not shown in detail.

ratings: Strong graphic violence and drug use, pervasive strong language and some sexuality

works.title: The Shawshank Redemption
works.summary: A banker sentenced to life for a murder he insists he did not commit finds friendship and quiet defiance inside a brutal prison.

graphic-violence: Beatings and a killing in prison.

works.title: The Dark Knight
works.summary: Batman, a reformist prosecutor and Gotham's police chief face a criminal who wants to prove anyone can be pushed into chaos.

graphic-violence: Intense, frequent violence and menace with little blood.

ratings: Intense sequences of violence and some menace

works.title: Inception
works.summary: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered his freedom for the opposite job: planting an idea.

graphic-violence: Gunfights and action without much blood.
suicide-self-harm: A suicide is a plot point.

ratings: Sequences of violence and action throughout

works.title: Interstellar
works.summary: With crops failing on Earth, a former pilot leaves his children to search for a new home through a wormhole near Saturn.
ratings: Some intense perilous action and brief strong language

works.title: The Matrix
works.summary: A hacker learns that the world he knows is a simulation built by machines, and that he may be the one to break it.

graphic-violence: Long stylised gunfights and martial arts.

works.title: Fight Club
works.summary: An insomniac office worker and a charismatic soap salesman start an underground fight club that grows into something far more dangerous.

sexual-content: Strong sexual content and brief nudity.

ratings: Disturbing and graphic depiction of violent anti-social behavior, sexuality and language

works.title: The Social Network
works.summary: The founding of Facebook, told through the lawsuits that followed it.

substance-use: Drinking and drug use at parties.

ratings: Sexual content, drug and alcohol use and language

works.title: Se7en
works.summary: Two detectives, one weeks from retirement, hunt a killer who stages each murder as one of the seven deadly sins.

body-horror: Grisly crime scenes shown in detail.

ratings: Grisly aftermath of violent crimes, terror, strong language and brief nudity

works.title: Jurassic Park
works.summary: A billionaire's island theme park of cloned dinosaurs gets its first visitors just as its systems fail.

works.title: Jaws
works.summary: A police chief, a marine biologist and a shark hunter go to sea after a great white terrorises a summer resort town.

works.title: Back to the Future
works.summary: A teenager accidentally travels thirty years back in a friend's time machine and has to make sure his parents still fall in love.

works.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
works.summary: A hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to destroy it.

graphic-violence: Battle sequences with orcs and monsters.

ratings: Epic battle sequences and some scary images

works.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
works.summary: The broken fellowship fights on two fronts as Frodo and Sam push toward Mordor with a treacherous guide.
ratings: Epic battle sequences and scary images

works.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
works.summary: Gondor faces the full army of Sauron while two hobbits make the last climb to Mount Doom.

jump-scares: A giant spider and the undead.

ratings: Intense epic battle sequences and frightening images

works.title: Star Wars

aka: Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope

works.summary: A farm boy, a smuggler and a princess join a rebellion against a galactic empire and its planet-killing battle station.

graphic-violence: Blaster fights and lightsaber duels with little blood.

works.title: Alien
works.summary: The crew of a commercial towing ship answers a distress signal and brings something aboard.

works.title: The Silence of the Lambs
works.summary: A trainee FBI agent seeks help from an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch a different killer.

body-horror: Mutilated bodies and a brutal escape.

works.title: Get Out
works.summary: A young Black photographer's weekend visit to his white girlfriend's family turns more sinister with every polite smile.

graphic-violence: Bloody violence in the final act.

ratings: Violence, bloody images, and language including sexual references

works.title: Hereditary
works.summary: After the family matriarch dies, her daughter's household begins to unravel under grief and something older.

body-horror: A shocking accident and disturbing images.

ratings: Horror violence, disturbing images, language, drug use and brief graphic nudity

works.title: The Shining
works.summary: A writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated mountain hotel with his wife and son, and the hotel begins to work on him.

works.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
works.summary: From the dawn of humankind to a mission toward Jupiter, mysterious monoliths mark the leaps of a species.

works.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
works.summary: After a painful breakup, a man has his memories of his ex erased, and changes his mind halfway through the procedure.
ratings: Language, some drug and sexual content

works.title: Her
works.summary: A lonely letter writer falls in love with the new operating system on his phone.
ratings: Language, sexual content and brief graphic nudity

works.title: La La Land
works.summary: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing dreams that pull them apart.

works.title: Whiplash
works.summary: A young jazz drummer at an elite conservatory is pushed to breaking point by a ferocious instructor.
ratings: Strong language including some sexual references

works.title: Moonlight
works.summary: Three chapters in the life of a quiet boy growing up in Miami, from childhood to adulthood.
ratings: Some sexuality, drug use, brief violence, and language throughout

works.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
works.summary: A laundromat owner being audited discovers she can borrow skills from versions of herself in other universes, just as the multiverse needs saving.
ratings: Some violence, sexual material and language

works.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
works.summary: The fastidious concierge of a grand European hotel and his lobby boy are drawn into a theft and a murder between the wars.
ratings: Language, some sexual content and violence

works.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
works.summary: A fox who promised to give up stealing chickens plans one last raid on three mean farmers.

works.title: Toy Story
works.summary: A pull-string cowboy, a boy's favourite toy, is threatened by the arrival of a space ranger who doesn't know he's a toy.

works.title: WALL-E
works.summary: The last cleaning robot on an abandoned Earth falls for a sleek probe and follows her into space.

works.title: Up
works.summary: A widowed balloon seller ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies off, with an eager boy scout stowed away.

works.title: Inside Out
works.summary: The emotions inside an eleven-year-old girl's head struggle to cope when her family moves to a new city.
ratings: Mild thematic elements and some action

works.title: Coco
works.summary: A Mexican boy who dreams of music, against his family's wishes, crosses into the Land of the Dead on the Day of the Dead.

works.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
works.summary: Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales gets spider powers just as Spider-People from other dimensions crash into his world.
ratings: Frenetic sequences of animated action violence, thematic elements and mild language

works.title: Black Panther
works.summary: The new king of the hidden African nation of Wakanda faces a challenger who wants its technology turned on the world.
ratings: Prolonged sequences of action violence, and a brief rude gesture

works.title: Oppenheimer
works.summary: The physicist who led the Manhattan Project builds the atomic bomb, then is tried for his doubts.

atrocity: The bomb's victims are evoked, not shown.

works.title: Barbie
works.summary: Stereotypical Barbie starts thinking about death and has to leave Barbieland for the real world to find out why.

works.title: Lady Bird
works.summary: A Sacramento teenager in her final year of Catholic school fights with her mother and plots her escape to the East Coast.
ratings: Language, sexual content, brief graphic nudity and teen partying

works.title: Little Women
works.summary: Four sisters come of age in Civil War-era Massachusetts, and Jo March writes her way to independence.

works.title: Dune
works.summary: The heir of a noble house arrives on a desert planet that produces the universe's most precious substance, and is betrayed.
ratings: Sequences of strong violence, some disturbing images and suggestive material

works.title: Dune: Part Two
works.summary: Paul Atreides joins the Fremen and rises toward a holy war he has foreseen and fears.
ratings: Sequences of strong violence, some disturbing images, suggestive material and brief strong language

works.title: No Country for Old Men
works.summary: A hunter takes the money from a drug deal gone wrong, and a relentless killer follows the money.
ratings: Strong graphic violence and some language

works.title: The Big Lebowski
works.summary: A laid-back bowler known as the Dude is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and dragged into a kidnapping scheme.
ratings: Pervasive strong language, drug use, some sexuality and brief violence

works.title: Fargo
works.summary: A car salesman's plan to have his wife kidnapped for the ransom goes wrong across snowbound Minnesota.

graphic-violence: Brutal, sudden violence including a woodchipper.

works.title: There Will Be Blood
works.summary: A ruthless oilman builds an empire in early twentieth-century California and wars with a young preacher.

works.title: Children of Men
works.summary: In a future where no child has been born for eighteen years, a weary bureaucrat must protect the first pregnant woman in a generation.
ratings: Strong violence, language, some drug use and brief nudity

works.title: Gravity
works.summary: A medical engineer on her first shuttle mission is left adrift when debris destroys her ship.
ratings: Intense perilous sequences, some disturbing images and brief strong language

works.title: Roma
works.summary: A live-in housekeeper for a middle-class family in 1970s Mexico City lives through a year of upheaval at home and in the streets.

atrocity: A student massacre in the streets.

ratings: Graphic nudity, some disturbing images and language

works.title: Pan's Labyrinth
works.summary: In 1944 Spain, the stepdaughter of a sadistic fascist officer is set three tasks by a faun in an overgrown labyrinth.

works.title: The Truman Show
works.summary: An insurance salesman slowly realises his entire life is a television show watched by millions.

works.title: Groundhog Day
works.summary: A cynical TV weatherman finds himself living the same small-town holiday over and over.

works.title: The Princess Bride
works.summary: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a tale of true love, pirates, giants and revenge.

graphic-violence: Sword fights, a torture machine played lightly.

works.title: Casablanca
works.summary: In wartime Morocco, a cynical nightclub owner has to choose between the woman he loves and helping her husband escape the Nazis.

works.title: 12 Angry Men
works.summary: One juror in a murder trial refuses to vote guilty, and the other eleven have to argue it out in a hot room.

works.title: Schindler's List
works.summary: A German industrialist who profits from the war comes to save more than a thousand Jewish workers from the Holocaust.
ratings: Language, some sexuality and actuality violence

works.title: Saving Private Ryan
works.summary: After the D-Day landings, a squad is sent behind enemy lines to bring home a private whose brothers have all been killed.
ratings: Intense prolonged realistically graphic sequences of war violence, and for language

works.title: The Thing
works.summary: Twelve men at an Antarctic research station realise a shape-shifting alien could be any one of them.

works.title: Knives Out
works.summary: When a wealthy crime novelist is found dead after his birthday party, an eccentric detective investigates his scheming family.
ratings: Thematic elements including brief violence, strong language, sexual references, and some drug material

works.title: The Prestige
works.summary: Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London sacrifice everything to outdo each other's greatest trick.

works.title: Memento
works.summary: A man who can't form new memories hunts his wife's killer using notes, photographs and tattoos.
ratings: Violence, language and some drug content

works.title: A Quiet Place
works.summary: A family survives in near-silence on a farm overrun by creatures that hunt by sound.

works.title: Top Gun: Maverick
works.summary: A veteran navy test pilot is called back to train young aviators, including his late friend's son, for an almost impossible mission.
ratings: Sequences of intense action, and some strong language

works.title: John Wick
works.summary: A retired hitman returns to the underworld he left after gangsters steal his car and kill the dog his late wife gave him.
ratings: Strong and bloody violence throughout, language and brief drug use

works.title: The Martian
works.summary: An astronaut presumed dead and left behind on Mars has to science his way to survival until a rescue can reach him.
ratings: Some strong language, injury images, and brief nudity

works.title: Gone Girl
works.summary: On his fifth wedding anniversary, a man's wife disappears, and the media decides he did it.
ratings: A scene of bloody violence, strong sexual content/nudity, and language

works.title: The Iron Giant
works.summary: In 1957 Maine, a boy befriends a giant metal robot from space while a government agent closes in.
ratings: Fantasy action violence and mild language

works.title: The Incredibles
works.summary: A family of superheroes forced into suburban anonymity are drawn back into action by a mysterious mission.

works.title: Shrek
works.summary: A grumpy ogre agrees to rescue a princess for a scheming lord, with a talking donkey he can't get rid of.
ratings: Mild language and some crude humor

works.title: The Lion King
works.summary: A lion cub flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to claim it from his uncle.

works.title: Frozen
works.summary: A princess sets out to find her estranged sister, whose powers have locked the kingdom in eternal winter.
ratings: Some action and mild rude humor

works.title: The Wizard of Oz
works.summary: A Kansas girl is carried by a tornado to a magical land and must reach its wizard to get home.

jump-scares: The witch and her flying monkeys.

relationships: Two takes on love and personhood with an artificial mind.
Both written by Andrew Niccol about lives engineered by others.
A single situation replayed until the hero changes.
